name: Arena PHP Agent 3
install_cmd: mkdir -p data data/localai data/localai/models storage storage/workspaces storage/localai storage/localai/models; chmod -R 775 data storage 2>/dev/null; "${PHP_BIN:-php}" -v && "${PHP_BIN:-php}" bin/console.php migrate && ("${PHP_BIN:-php}" bin/console.php doctor || true)
start_cmd: "${PHP_BIN:-php}" bin/console.php migrate; ("${PHP_BIN:-php}" bin/console.php ai:serve >> storage/localai-boot.log 2>&1 || true); ("${PHP_BIN:-php}" bin/worker.php --interval 2 >> storage/worker.log 2>&1 &); exec "${PHP_BIN:-php}" -S "${HOST:-0.0.0.0}:${PORT:-8099}" -t public public/index.php
